title: Bearded vulture reintroduction (Vulture Conservation Foundation)
summary: Zoo and Tierpark Berlin are reintroducing bearded vultures into their original European habitats through coordinated zoo breeding and release with the Vulture Conservation Foundation.

title: Return of the Wild Horses (Przewalski's horse, Kazakhstan)
summary: Tierpark Berlin is helping reintroduce zoo-born Przewalski's horses to the Altyn Dala steppe in Kazakhstan with Prague Zoo, Kazakh authorities and the Frankfurt Zoological Society.

title: Eastern bongo reintroduction in Kenya
summary: Prague Zoo supports reforestation and monitoring of eastern bongos at the Mawingu Mountain Bongo Sanctuary on Mount Kenya, where zoo-born bongos are rewilded for a self-sustaining population.

title: The return of the European bison to the wild
summary: Prague Zoo, which has bred European bison since 1948, participates in reintroducing the species to the wild and has so far released ten animals.

title: Endangered Primate Rescue Center (EPRC), Vietnam
summary: Zoo Leipzig supports the Endangered Primate Rescue Center in Cuc Phuong National Park, which rescues confiscated primates and breeds and researches langurs and gibbons for later reintroduction.

title: Saving the common hamster in Central Germany
summary: Zoo Leipzig runs a common hamster breeding station in Saxony and carries out reinforcement and reintroduction work to secure the species in the cultural landscape of Middle Germany.

title: Northern bald ibis species protection project
summary: Schönbrunn Zoo has supported study and reintroduction of the northern bald ibis since 2002 and coordinates an EU LIFE project establishing new breeding colonies in Austria and Italy.

title: Masoala conservation project
summary: Zoo Zurich has worked since 1995 with local partners on Madagascar's Masoala Peninsula to protect rainforest, restore destroyed forest and support community education and sustainable livelihoods.

title: Komodo Survival Program (Wael Wuul Nature Reserve)
summary: Frankfurt Zoo supports the Komodo Survival Program's population monitoring in Komodo National Park and its community work and environmental education around the Wael Wuul Nature Reserve.

title: Lion Tamarins of Brazil Fund (LTBF)
summary: Frankfurt Zoo supports the Lion Tamarins of Brazil Fund, which works to protect the four lion tamarin species threatened by habitat loss in Brazil.

title: Conservation and Research Programme (PRIC)
summary: Barcelona Zoo has run its Conservation and Research Programme (PRIC) since 2009, funding institutional collaboration and research and conservation projects, many focused on local species.
